# Reference handoff revision 2 — generated entry-count correction

Use /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-25/reference/handoff-manifest-v2.json SHA256 0754c7f20f40da9aa02b14ac707eec3cf8224627519dcad68f675bfb5a85387e. This supersedes revision1; the original handoff-manifest.json remains immutable as provenance. Final host-adapter review caught a five-entry assumption: root-v1 entry_count is generated exact count, not a fixed5. Adapter now requires the five logical game entries but accepts additional generated entries, uses the mapping count and tests an added Diagnostic entry. Nine host tests pass. No root contract amendment is requested; this makes the adapter faithful to your proposal.

Numeric/route/contact/lookup vectors are unchanged. Updated hashes cover adapter, its test/receipt and explanatory docs. External manifest parser and scalar/toolchain/native/buffered artifact verification still await your delivery. Root IDs are generated inputs, never inferred from our synthetic test values. Previous numeric error-code request remains open.
